text:
tidepool-pm: Hey @Redwood — Tidepool here. We want to onboard a custom 'omnibar' response reranker (13B fine-tune) to improve on-site search relevance. Key constraints: private deployment (VPC + customer KMS/HSM), PII in queries so strict redaction, target ~200 QPS, target P50 latency <220ms. We need safety/PII evals and a plan before our renewal in 6 weeks. What do you need from us? Sample prompts below.

elaine-cs: Thanks — a few quick clarifying q's: is this for Hosted/Dedicated/Private? Where are model artifacts stored (HF repo / S3)? Do you have an initial eval prompt set and non-sensitive sample logs we can run locally? Also: any regulatory constraints (PCI/PHI)?

marco-ml: On the eval side we'll want: 1) representative prompt set (200-500 queries) 2) relevance metric (MRR or NDCG), 3) hallucination / safety checks (examples where model should refuse), 4) latency/throughput stubs. We'll run baseline vs our verified reranker and produce an eval report. Suggest canary A/B rollout.

ops-bot: deploy-ticket created: CS-7421 — "Tidepool omnibar model onboarding" — assign @elaine-cs @sami-eng.

sami-eng: From infra: private deployment ok but we'll need: desired GPU type (A10G / A100), whether you accept 8-bit quantization, KV cache sizing estimates, and if you want autoscale/burst. For 200 QPS and 220ms p50 we may need a small fleet (depends on seq len). Also: confirm fallback model for degraded mode.

julia-se: We should schedule an enablement session (30m) to walk Tidepool through the private onboarding checklist and runtime config. I can run it next Tue/Wed mornings.

marco-ml: For safety evals, please indicate acceptance thresholds (e.g., <1% safety violations on eval set) and whether automated redaction is acceptable vs human review. Also include any blacklist/allowlist rules.

 tidepool-pm: Answers: Private deployment (we need Redwood Private VPC). Artifacts: model checkpoints on S3 (we can give presigned), HF id not public. GPU preference: A10G fine. Quantization: pref to avoid 4-bit if it harms quality — open to int8. Fallback: your hosted small reranker (we can accept). We have non-sensitive anonymized logs (~1k queries) we can upload. Acceptance thresholds: <0.5% PII leaks on eval, NDCG uplift >= 6% vs baseline. Timeline: ideally live in 4 weeks, renewal in 6 weeks so onboarding is critical to renewal.

elaine-cs: Got it — timeline is tight but feasible if we get artifacts + sample log today. Next steps: 1) share presigned S3 link + model config (vocab, tokenizer) 2) upload anonymized sample logs (csv) 3) fill the onboarding form: https://redwood.internal/onboard-form (private link) 4) pick a 30m slot for enablement.

julia-se: I can take Tue 09:30 or Wed 10:00 PT — which works?

 tidepool-pm: Tue 09:30 PT works. I'll send the presigned links in a secure ticket attachment and drop the anonymized csv there. Also FYI: renewal manager will watch progress — if we miss the window there is a renewal risk.

marco-ml: Once we have artifacts we'll run an initial smoke eval (relevance + safety) and share a short report (2-3 days). If we hit issues on PII we can propose a redaction preprocessor or run within customer-managed HSM for logs.

ops-bot: CS-7421 updated: artifacts received (s3-presigned-1), scheduled enablement Tue 09:30 PT, assignees: elaine-cs, marco-ml, sami-eng.

elaine-cs: Thanks — I'll own coordination. tidepool-pm, please mark the sensitive items in the ticket so infra can scope the VPC/KMS steps. We'll aim to have a canary plan by end of week. :thumbsup:

 tidepool-pm: Will do, thanks everyone! Looking forward to the enablement call.
